rows.en: Man… the Iron Mask Party caught me and I went through a real ordeal!
"I'm a human bomb with a timer! Stop Ken! Their targets are you and Ken, Boss…"

…!?

Ken! I'm coming now! Wait right there a moment!
Huh? Uh, okay…
Heh heh heh… Nice weather. I'm getting kinda hungry, too.

"The entrance to the Iron Mask Party's undersea secret base is past these dunes!

The time bomb goes off in one more minute. Don't follow me!"
Daisaku…
What's with you guys… We haven't seen each other in ages and you're all making such gloomy faces?
Daisaku… Don't tell me you're…!?
Daisaku…

"One last thing…

King Deviler's weak point is the automatic control unit built into its abdomen! Aim for it with the new weapon, the Drill Arrow!"

Everyone…

Hate the Iron Mask Party! And fight! Well, everyone! Take care…
That brat… He means to betray us! Flip the detonator switch!
Daisaku…!?
Daisaku… You sacrificed your own life to tell us the Iron Mask Party's secrets?
Daisakuuu! Uuugh, Daisaku…

Don't cry, Mari… Daisaku died for our sake, leaving us with a smile…

We're going to infiltrate the undersea base! This is it, Ken!

Curse that brat… So he did betray us!

Rampage, King Deviler! Show them the wrath of the Iron Mask Party!
Come on, then! King Deviler!
This is what Daisaku was talking about!
It's a staircase going underground…
This is the secret passage… Daisaku told us about it in exchange for his life.

We go in here and plant time bombs!

Once you've planted your bomb, come back here and wait! …Got it?

Let's synchronize our watches!

There are probably human-detection devices all over the inside! It's dangerous for the three of us to go together! We'll split up…

Thirty minutes from now, back here… All right, let's go!
Right!
Boss!
Are you all right?
I've set the timer!
Boss!
How did it go on your end?
Success!

Good… But there's no way we can break through any further!

No choice… I'll hit the detonator switch here and now!
If you do that…
Listen. It's all or nothing! Get out under cover of the chaos from the explosion!
What about you, Boss?
I'll plant one more, then follow you!

Boss… You mean to get Daisaku's wristwatch back, don't you?

I'm going too!
Me too!

No… In a place like this, it's easier to move alone!

That's an order! Get out, now!
What is all this commotion!?
Someone has infiltrated the base… and planted bombs!
What!?
Don't move, Deviler!
You!? Ogo…?
I'll have Daisaku's wristwatch back!

Damn… In that case, we abandon the undersea base and escape!

This is not the Iron Mask Party's only base!
What!?
Uwaaaah…!
The undersea base blew up!
Boss…
Ah… Deviler's spaceship is getting away!
It can't be!? Is the Boss inside that…?
Boss! Please respond! Boss!

Uuugh…

Where am I!?

…!? Uuugh… Ogo here!
Boss! What about Deviler?
Don't worry… I took care of Deviler! He was a cyborg!

What!?

Boss… Where are you right now?
It seems I'm in space right now?
Space!?

Deviler's command room turned straight into a spaceship!

It's flying on autopilot… Looks like it's going to be picked up somewhere.
Boss…

Ken, Tetsuya, Mari… listen to me carefully!

We may well have buried the Iron Mask Party! But the evil organizations, starting with that space fortress… are still rampant on Earth!

Don't let your guard down! They'll launch an all-out attack, I'm sure of it! But if you join forces… if you join forces, you will win for sure! I'm counting on you!

Ken… I got the wristwatch back!

No need to worry anymore! Red Baron is an invincible robot!

But…

if this spaceship gets picked up by someone, Red Baron's secrets will be in danger again…

I won't let that happen!
Boss! Boss!
(Farewell, Earth! And… farewell, SSI…)
Bosssss! Boss…
Captain! We've picked up a strange signal!

Heh heh heh… Don't think you've won!

Until now, we have been secretly making good use of the resources Earthlings threw away. This warship robot was born that way too! Using the Iron Mask Party's undersea base…

You humans seem to think you are the most superior creatures, but that is a great mistake!

In this vast universe there are many things you do not know. You are simply ignorant!

Be careful… The things you carelessly throw away, the things you waste, the things you kill… someday they will surely come back to bite you!

The real enemy is often closer than you think… Go on tormenting yourselves with your own hands!

Even in this vast universe, creatures as foolish as you are quite rare… Hahaha!
The Mimi Alien is right! Unless we change for the sake of peace, true happiness will never come.
My…
So this is the operations command room… It's a far cry from our HQ, huh?

Members of the SSI… I am Director Yamaoka! The loss of two SSI members is truly regrettable…

But we cannot go on grieving forever. Let me introduce your new commander.
He is both your commander and a member of our TDF Science Group, Dr. Mikami…
Dr. Mikami mainly helped us develop Red Baron's Space Wings.
I'm Shiro Mikami…
You're the doctor…!?
Don't call me "Doctor"! Let's just use first names…
